---
title: "Python and automation"
description: "Python tutorials for data import, automation, analysis and visualisation with PEExcel."
---

Choose a tutorial for your task. Each guide explains requirements, data sources and steps, and includes a notebook download with saved results. Read it online or run it in a cloned repository.

The German tutorials are edited versions. The original [working how-to notebooks](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel/tree/master/notebooks) remain available, partly in English and with further experiments. **Tutorial links below open the existing German pages; their saved outputs are reused.**

## Overview and getting started

These tutorials add programmatic workflows to Excel. For operation and technical foundations, see [getting started](excel-overview.qmd), [modelling](model.qmd), [analysis](results.qmd) and [declaration](projekte-nachweisen.qmd). [Terms, parameters and indicators](glossary.qmd) explains terminology and the complete OUT catalogue.

## Preparing Python

Install once in the cloned repository:

```bash
python -m pip install -e ".[publication]"
```

Tutorials use existing `pexl` functions. Python reads and analyses saved exports; changed inputs are calculated in Excel. The website displays saved outputs and runs no simulation.
